info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Call Information API

params.name: call_control_id
params.description: Unique identifier and token for controlling the call

items.docs: Returns the status of a call (data is available 10 minutes after call ended).

info.name: List all active calls for given connection

params.name: page
params.description: Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[after], page[before], page[limit], page[size], page[number]

items.docs: Lists all active calls for given connection. Acceptable connections are either SIP connections with webhook_url or xml_request_url, call control or texml. Returned results are cursor paginated.
